camera.motion: static (background phase-correlation shift vs frame 0 < 0.15 px in every frame; scripts/camera_check.py)
camera.view: slightly elevated, looking down at a room corner; floor visible in lower half, grey wall panels behind
camera.perspective_cues: floor plane occupies y > ~450 px; wall/floor junction runs diagonally from ~(560,330) towards ~(1280,520) behind the person; the pendulum swings mostly along the camera depth axis, so the ball's apparent size changes by ~1.4x across a swing

ball.description: small bright orange/red ball (pendulum bob) hanging on a thin light string from the person's outstretched right hand
ball.reference_point: centroid of the orange colour mask (visible centre)

apparent_diameter_px.note: strict-mask equivalent diameter; bbox 26-28 px far, 36-41 px near; true edge probably 1-2 px larger (blurred rim)

string.description: thin light-coloured string from the pinch of the hand to the top of the ball (pendulum string)

pivot_px.note: hand pinch point, nearly fixed: x ~639 in frames 10-26, ~634 in frames 38-48; y 224-230

pivot_to_ball_centre_image_px.far_end: foreshortened to ~20-50 px (string points away from camera)

person_holding.description: standing woman in light-blue denim overalls and black top, face blurred, right arm extended to her right (image left) holding the pendulum string; stands right of the ball
person_holding.note: holds still; only the hand drifts ~5 px left over the clip

seated_person.description: person in grey shirt seated at a desk in the background left (blurred)

black_pole.description: vertical dark pole/stand behind the ball

diagonal_black_bar.description: dark diagonal bar/stand at right edge

floor_markings.description: reddish markings/tape on the grey carpet floor, around and left of the person
